items.meta_title: Quick Launch: Connect From the Notification Bar | VpnHood!
items.meta_description: Quick Launch adds a tile to the Android quick settings panel so you can connect to the VPN in a single tap. Available in VpnHood!
items.title: Quick Launch
items.lead: Connect to the VPN instantly from the notification bar with a single tap.
items.shot_alt: The Quick Launch screen in the VpnHood! app
items.platforms: Android only, as quick settings tiles are an Android feature, and on VpnHood! CONNECT it needs Premium.
items.how_desc: Adds a VpnHood! tile to the Android quick settings panel. One tap on it connects you to the server you used last and another disconnects, from any screen, without opening the app.
items.when_desc: If you connect and disconnect through the day. To stay connected all the time, Always On suits you better.
items.cost_desc: Nothing in speed or battery. It is a shortcut, not a change to how the VPN works.
items.steps_desc: Connect once from the app first, so the tile knows which server to use. Then add the tile from the app on Android 13 and later, or by hand on any version.
items.app_step1: Open the menu, tap Settings, then Quick Launch.
items.app_step3: When Android asks, add the tile.
items.app_fallback: If Android doesn't ask, add the tile by hand instead.
items.hand_step1: Swipe down from the top of the screen to open Quick Settings.
items.hand_step2: Tap the edit button, a pencil or + on most phones.
items.hand_step3: Find the VpnHood! tile among the tiles you can add.
items.hand_step4: Touch and hold it, then drag it up among your active tiles.
items.hand_step5: Tap Done, or go back, to save.
